summaries.title: Retroformer: Retrospective Large Language Agents with Policy Gradient Optimization
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**智能体与代码工程**（Agents & SWE）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Retroformer** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）。核心论点主张：This paper introduces a principled framework for reinforcing large language agents by learning a retrospective model, which automatically tunes the language agent prompts...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Although some agents enable iterative refinement through verbal feedback, they do not reason and plan in ways that are compatible with gradient-based...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Experimental results on various tasks demonstrate that the language agents improve over time and that our approach considerably outperforms baselines that do not properly leverage...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 21 赞），本工作为突破 **智能体与代码工程** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: MM-Vet: Evaluating Large Multimodal Models for Integrated Capabilities

summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Code and data are available at）。

summaries.title: Scaling Clinical Trial Matching Using Large Language Models: A Case Study in Oncology

summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Clinical trial matching is a key process in health delivery and discovery。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（While still far from perfect, LLMs substantially outperform prior strong baselines and may serve as a preliminary...；Our study also reveals a few significant growth areas for applying LLMs to end-to-end clinical trial matching,...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 13 赞），本工作为突破 **科学智能 (生物/化学/物理/医疗)** 中的「对人工先验规则或定制化流水线的过度依赖」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。
